facts.text: CMakeLists builds the shared library dave_ocean_current_plugin from src/ocean_current_plugin.cpp.
A shipped world loads libdave_ocean_current_plugin.so with namespace hydrodynamics and current topic current_velocity.
The ROS plugin returns without loading when ROS is not initialized, reads the namespace from the SDF (empty when absent) and builds ros::NodeHandle(ns).
The ROS plugin advertises geometry_msgs::TwistStamped on currentVelocityTopic with queue size 10.
The world plugin reads constant_current/topic from the SDF and defaults it to the literal current_velocity.
The constructor sets rosPublishPeriod to 0.05 s.
ConnectWorldUpdateBegin calls OnUpdateCurrentVel, which publishes only after rosPublishPeriod, stamps frame_id /world and copies the current vector into twist.linear x, y and z.

The world plugin's Update sets the current vector to magnitude * cos(h) * cos(v), magnitude * sin(h) * cos(v) and magnitude * sin(v) from the velocity, horizontal-angle and vertical-angle processes, under a comment that names the NED frame.
The world plugin's Load logs 'WARNING: Current velocity calculated in the ENU frame'.
The world plugin advertises the Gazebo msgs::Vector3d topic ns/currentVelocityTopic.
The ROS plugin advertises the relative get_current_velocity_model service with the GetCurrentVelocityModel callback.
GetCurrentVelocityModel takes dave_gazebo_ros_plugins::GetCurrentModel and replies with the velocity model mean, min, max, noise and mu.
The ROS plugin advertises the relative get_current_horz_angle_model service with the GetCurrentHorzAngleModel callback.
GetCurrentHorzAngleModel takes GetCurrentModel and replies with the horizontal-angle model mean, min, max, noise and mu.
The get_current_vert_angle_model service is advertised with the GetCurrentHorzAngleModel callback.
The ROS plugin advertises the relative set_current_velocity service with the UpdateCurrentVelocity callback.
UpdateCurrentVelocity calls SetMean on the velocity, horizontal-angle and vertical-angle models in a short-circuit && chain and sets success true only when all three calls return true.
SetMean returns false when the requested mean is outside the configured min and max; on success it stores the mean and resets the process variable to it.
GaussMarkovProcess::Update multiplies the process variable by (1 - step * mu), adds noiseAmp times a uniform draw in [-0.5, 0.5] and clamps the result to [min, max].

The ROS plugin also advertises set_current_velocity_model, set_current_horz_angle_model, set_current_vert_angle_model, set_stratified_current_velocity, set_current_horz_angle, set_stratified_current_horz_angle, set_current_vert_angle and set_stratified_current_vert_angle.
For each stratified-database row the world plugin creates magnitude, horizontal-angle and vertical-angle Gauss-Markov models whose means come from the row (vertical 0).
Each publish period the ROS plugin also publishes the stratified-database rows with the tidal harmonic or tidal-table data and the ebb and flood directions.
The transient-current model plugin subscribes to the stratified-current database topic.
The transient-current model plugin picks the database row for the vehicle's depth from the model's world pose.

rexrov_oberon7_transient_current.xacro loads libdave_ocean_current_model_plugin.so with flow_velocity_topic hydrodynamics/current_velocity/$(arg namespace) and tide_oscillation true, and gives libuuv_underwater_object_ros_plugin.so the same flow_velocity_topic.
rexrov_oberon7.xacro gives libuuv_underwater_object_ros_plugin.so the flow_velocity_topic hydrodynamics/current_velocity.
For the constant-current velocity model the world plugin reads mean, min, max, mu and noiseAmp from the SDF and asserts min < max, mean within min and max, mu in [0, 1) and noiseAmp in [0, 1).

The shipped current-profiling world configures the velocity model with mean 0, min 0 and max 5.0 and both angle models with mean 0, min -3.141592653589793 and max 3.141592653589793, each with mu 0.0 and noiseAmp 0.0.
SetCurrentVelocity.srv declares float64 velocity, horizontal_angle and vertical_angle requests and a bool success response.
GetCurrentModel.srv declares float64 mean, min, max, noise and mu response fields.
The shipped integrated demo includes gazebo_ros empty_world.launch with use_sim_time true.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned-response fake with placeholder current vectors and model values; it does not advance a Gauss-Markov process, Gazebo world clock or trajectory, so it establishes no seeded or state-hash replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS canned-response fake (no Gazebo physics or current model)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free protocol transport: it answers the declared current topic, the two get-model services and the set-current service and runs no Gazebo world, DAVE plugin, physics, sensor or wall-clock loop
the current vector and model values are placeholders; the fake computes the TwistStamped vector from placeholder magnitude and angles and does not advance the Gauss-Markov process

the set-current fake updates the model means and mirrors the native short-circuit partial application, but it does not prove that a later world update publishes the requested current or that the stochastic model remains there

the zero-current request and the e-stop change only the global constant-current models: the stratified-database models and the tidal data, from which the transient-current model plugin (rexrov_oberon7_transient_current, smilodon_gazebo_transient_current) computes each vehicle's own flow topic, are unchanged, so such vehicles keep their current after an e-stop

after the e-stop any ROS client can set a new current or model through this plugin's set_current_velocity, set_current_velocity_model, angle and stratified setters; the MHS latch refuses only this driver's commands
with a non-zero velocity noiseAmp the process random-walks away from zero again within the configured range after the request; the shipped current-profiling world sets noiseAmp 0
the clone is inconsistent about the frame of the current vector (Update's comment names NED, Load and the set services log ENU); the driver passes twist.linear through unchanged
the clone publishes /hydrodynamics/current_velocity from the world update callback; the topic can be silent while the Gazebo world is paused, and the fake instead answers a subscription immediately

the clone advertises get_current_vert_angle_model with the horizontal-angle callback; the driver does not expose that broken vertical read, and the vertical angle is visible only through the current vector
the driver does not expose the stratified-current topics and services, the spherical-coordinate interface, robot dynamics, Gazebo stepping, pause or reset; those are NOT COVERED
the upstream namespace hydrodynamics is a shipped world setting; a deployment that uses a different namespace or remapping must expose the resolved endpoints recorded here
the service request ranges are world configuration; no live site envelope is supplied by this package

safe_state.description: The fixed set_current_velocity(0, 0, 0) request zeroes the global constant-current means and SetMean resets each process to its mean, so the global current is zero from the next world update while the velocity noiseAmp is 0; it is refused when a configured range excludes zero (the velocity mean may then already be zero). Transient-current vehicles keep their stratified and tidal current, Gazebo keeps running and any ROS client can set a new current.
